name: diff
description: Unified diffs between two files or directory trees, plus a JSON change summary (--stat). Exit code mirrors diff(1): 0 identical, 1 differences, 2 error — so agents can branch on 'did anything change'.
use_when: comparing file versions, generated vs expected output, or directory trees

args.name: --recursive
args.description: Recurse into subdirectories for dir comparisons.

args.name: --stat
args.description: Emit JSON {changed_files, files:[{file,added,removed}]} instead of the diff text.

stdout: Unified diff text, or JSON summary with --stat.

exit_codes.2: error (missing path, no diff binary for dirs)
